pois.name: Εβραϊκό Μουσείο Ρόδου
pois.intro: The Jewish Museum of Rhodes is a museum located in the Old Town of the island of Rhodes, eastern Greece. It was established by Aron Hasson of the Rhodes Jewish Historical Foundation in 1997 to preserve the Jewish history and culture of Rhodes.

pois.name: Ακρόπολη Ρόδου
pois.description: Unfortified Hellenistic acropolis (3rd–2nd c. BC) with temples of Apollo Pythios, Athena Polias & Zeus Polieus, a stadium, odeion, gymnasium, library, nymphaea and cavernous sanctuaries
pois.intro: The Acropolis of Rhodes is the acropolis, or upper town, of ancient Rhodes dating from the 5th century BC and located 3 kilometers SW from the centre of the modern city.

pois.name: Μουσείο Αρχαίας Ελληνικής Τεχνολογίας Ρόδου
pois.nameEnglish: Rhodes Museum of Ancient Greek Technology

pois.name: Μεσαιωνική Πόλη της Ρόδου
pois.intro: The Medieval City of Rhodes was constructed around 1309 to 1523 and is part of the modern capital city of Rhodes on the Island of Rhodes in Greece. The site was added to the UNESCO World Heritage list in 1988.

pois.name: Ενυδρείο
pois.description: 1935 Art Déco building for studying the hydrobiology, the sponges, fisheries of the Aegean sea and hosting an aquarium with interesting species of the marine fauna of the Mediterranean.
pois.intro: The Aquarium of Rhodes, also known as the Hydrobiological Station of Rhodes, is a research centre, aquarium and museum in Rhodes, Greece. It was built in the 1930s, when the island was under the Italian rule and is currently administered by the Hellenic Centre for Marine Research.

pois.name: Φιλέρημος
pois.intro: Filerimos ist der Name eines 267 Meter hohen Berges auf der griechischen Insel Rhodos, etwa 8 km südwestlich der Hauptstadt Rhodos.

pois.name: Αρχαίο Στάδιο
pois.description: Hellenistic stadium (rebuilt after 227/226 BC earthquake), 200.76 m (600 Rhodian feet) long. Site of the Halieia festival dedicated to Helios. Capacity 28,000-30,000 spectators.
pois.intro: El Estadio de Rodas era un antiguo estadio griego situado en la ciudad de Rodas, en la isla del mismo nombre, en Grecia.​ Sus ruinas se encuentran en la zona arqueológica de la acrópolis de la ciudad, en el lado occidental de la actual ciudad de Rodas. Se construyó en el periodo helenístico, en el siglo II a.

pois.name: Μουσείο Νεοελληνικής Τέχνης του Δήμου Ρόδου
Παλάτι του Μεγάλου Μαγίστρου των Ιπποτών της Ρόδου
pois.nameEnglish: Palace of the Grand Master of the Knights of Rhodes

pois.name: Νυμφαία
pois.description: Four subterranean rock-cut grottoes with entrance steps, passages, roof openings, water cisterns and niches for statuettes, used for worship and recreation. Exact deities worshipped unknown.

pois.name: Γυμνάσιο
pois.description: Large Hellenistic gymnasium (~200 m per side). Only part of the stylobate on its southern side has been excavated.

pois.name: Ναός Αθηνάς Πολιάδος και Διός Πολιέως
pois.nameEnglish: Temple of Athena Polias and Zeus Polieus
pois.description: Doric peripteral temple in porous stone with colonnades on all four sides. Nine oversized column drums, a capital and architrave fragments on the ground attest its monumental scale. Housed the Rhodians' written treaties with other states.

pois.name: Βιβλιοθήκη
pois.description: Partially restored with eight blind arches. Part of the Gymnasium complex.

pois.name: Αρχαία Ιαλυσός
pois.description: Remains of buildings from the Archaic, Byzantine and Knights' periods. The temple of Athena Polias, which dates to the 3rd-2nd c. BC, was built over the site of an earlier Classical temple
pois.intro: Ialysus or Ialysos, also Ialyssus or Ialyssos, or Ielyssus or Ielyssos, was a city of ancient Rhodes.

pois.name: Ναός Αρτέμιδος
pois.description: Temple in the same temenos as the Temple of Apollo Pythios, founded on a high podium in a sunken courtyard. Attribution to Artemis disputed; most researchers now associate it with the worship of Helios.

pois.name: Σπηλαιώδες Ιερό
pois.description: Two rectangular rock-cut rooms connected by internal door, built in late Hellenistic period. Southern room had two Doric columns, plaster facade and niches for statuettes. Northern room with vaulted ceiling. Precinct extends south to ancient road P18.

pois.name: Mineralogy Museum
pois.intro: Het Mineralogisch-paleontologisch Museum Stamatiadis bevindt zich op het Griekse eiland Rhodos. Het museum werd opgericht in 2008 door Polichronis Stamatiadis.

pois.name: Ανεμόμυλοι στο Μανδράκι
pois.description: 3 Mélanges médiévaux pour broyer directement des céréales pour l'expédition à l'exportation. / 3 Molinos de viento medievales para moler el grano para ser exportado. /3 remaining medieval windmills for directly grinding grain for export shipping. /

pois.name: Ιπποτών
pois.description: 600m medieval cobbled streets with ancient inns

pois.name: Πάρκο Ροδίνι
pois.intro: Der Rodini Park ist ein Park auf der griechischen Insel Rhodos im südlichen Teil von Rhodos, etwa 3 Kilometer vom Stadtzentrum entfernt. Der Park wurde in seiner heutigen Form von den Italienern in der Zeit der Besetzung in einer Schlucht angelegt, deren Eingang sich an der Straße nach Lindos befindet.

pois.name: Elafos
pois.description: Male deer, supposedly in location of Colossus of Rhodes. Part of a pair male/female
